candidates.name: Spondylodiscitis
support_spans: lumbar spinal tenderness and bilateral leg weakness without sensory loss
MRI of the lumbar spine demonstrated decreased T1 signal and increased T2 and STIR signal at L4–L5
Blood cultures grew Enterobacter cloacae
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of low back pain, fever, and leg weakness, combined with the MRI findings and positive blood cultures, suggest a diagnosis of spondylodiscitis, which is an infection of the intervertebral disc space.
